sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Flappy Eros, the core gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging. Players control Eros, a bird that must navigate through levels filled with obstacles, collecting hearts and power-ups to boost their chances of success. The game uses a tap-to-fly mechanic, where players tap the screen to make Eros flap its wings and fly upwards. The game also features a gravity mechanic, where Eros will naturally fall downwards unless it flaps its wings. Players must time their taps perfectly to avoid obstacles and stay alive. As players progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging, requiring players to think strategically and make quick decisions to stay ahead.

The game also features a variety of obstacles, from swooping birds to treacherous terrain. Players must avoid these obstacles at all costs, as they will result in a game over. The game also features a variety of power-ups, from speed boosts to shields, that players can collect to boost their chances of success. These power-ups can be used strategically to overcome obstacles and stay alive.

One of the key features of Flappy Eros is its scoring system. Players earn points for collecting hearts and power-ups, and for surviving levels without crashing. The game also features a high score leaderboard, where players can compete with others to earn the top spot. This adds a competitive element to the game, encouraging players to play again and again to improve their score.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Flappy Eros are simple yet challenging. The game requires strategic thinking and quick decision-making, making it a great choice for players of all ages and skill levels.
